disclaimer: All seven Scenekunst underbadges are mapped to approved separate WebPs. Older v1 prototypes remain in the repository only as historical rejected candidates. By and Film & TV underbadges remain unactivated.
parentProtection: Do not alter any existing main badge or approved subbadge images.

style.format: single standalone circular patch per source file, no contact sheets or crops
style.text: Category title MUST be spelled correctly and embroidered INSIDE the badge along the upper inner curved border. No captions or hex codes outside.
style.palette: category approved primary and secondary; small neutral accents only
style.qualityGate: visual signoff is mandatory; automated image checks alone are insufficient
style.publication: inactive until visual approval, repository WebP upload, hash verification and explicit category mapping
style.imageSourceQualityNote: Prototype files derived from a triptych; do not automatically mark as approved or reuse them for other IDs.
style.visualReference: Match existing realistic raised-thread/stitched textile badges, never flat vector icons.

parentCategoryLabel.location: curved INNER bottom rim, stitched within patch (never external text)
parentCategoryLabel.threadColor: muted light parent category secondary color, legible at 64px
parentCategoryLabel.source: parent category name from data/badges/*.json, no guessed label
parentCategoryLabel.note: Already approved images remain unchanged until separately reviewed and updated; retroactive rollout is not part of this PR
